IT_load.note: Input. How busy the servers are, in % of their full load: it drives the IT electricity.

T_outdoor.note: Input. Outdoor temperature, °C: how hard the cooling works, how much it free-cools.

humidity.note: Input. Outdoor relative humidity, %: the cooling tower's wet bulb.

solar_radiation.note: Input. Solar radiation, W/m²: no data here, a variable to make.

IT_power.note: Output. Electricity of the servers, kW: nearly all of it becomes heat.

Cooling_power.note: Output. Electricity of the cooling plant (chiller, fans, pumps), kW.

Supply_temp.note: Output. Water to the heat distribution at the connection point, °C (the warm supply).

Return_temp.note: Input. Water back from the heat distribution, °C: the return, set by the heat distribution.

Water_flow.note: Output. Mass flow of the water to the heat distribution, kg/s.

Heat_rejected.note: Output. Heat the cooling rejects outdoors, kW: IT + cooling electricity − Heat_recovered.
